Small moments. A clearer picture of your day.

Pinch helps you keep track of sodium, one meal at a time. This release brings the app interface to 14 languages, so your daily routine can feel a little more familiar.

• Log foods and see your daily sodium total against a goal you choose.
• Keep favorites close and add familiar foods again with quick add.
• Enter sodium in milligrams or salt in grams from your food labels.
• Choose optional meal reminders that fit your routine.

Want a wider view? Pinch Plus adds four-week trends, a salt calendar, FatSecret food search, CSV export and a Home Screen widget.

Your diary doesn't have to be perfect. Start with your next meal.
